business_idea: A subscription meal-prep service delivering healthy, locally-sourced dinners to busy professionals
target_customer: Urban working professionals aged 25-45 who value health but lack time to cook
problem_solved: Busy professionals struggle to eat healthy on weeknights and rely on expensive takeout
product_service: Weekly boxes of 5 chef-designed, pre-portioned dinners with 15-minute cook times
revenue_model: Subscription: $89/week for 5 dinners, with tiered plans and add-ons
competitors: HelloFresh, Blue Apron, Factor, local meal-prep kitchens
unique_advantage: Hyper-local sourcing partnerships and 15-minute cook times vs competitors' 30-40 minutes
